question:
Code-Review round 1 of task config-test-cut stopped on decision finding F3, and the board entry and decision record leave it open.
internal/hubreconcile/testmain_integration_test.go:36 now installs one scripted notifier, mailRecorder.send, for the whole test binary. It records each mail and answers posted, unposted or an error, as each test sets for its board.
On main, the same scripted answers came from recordNotices / recordNoticesAnswering in reinterpret_integration_test.go. Each test that wanted them installed them for itself, and docs/research/no-fake-other-modules/fabric-batten.md:82 lists them as a standing fake to be replaced by the production orchcli notifier over a real box.
The binary-wide install is what lets the walks run in parallel, since InstallNotifier holds a single notifier for the whole process.
It also means walks in tests that installed no notifier now mail into the recorder instead of taking the nil-notifier branch.
In reinterpret.go:148-150 that branch only logs "no notifier is installed", and one row still uninstalls the recorder to cover it (reinterpret_integration_test.go:70-71).
Does PATTERN-test-stand-ins' standing-fakes clause allow this widened use of the inventoried fake until the sweep replaces it?
If it does, run `lym loom circling accept config-test-cut`; the gating findings F1 and F2 are already fixed in commits 696b04c4e and 6bbb44653.
If it does not, the fix means driving the real notifier, which is beyond this test-only cut. In that case, file a board note for the sweep task and still decide accept or continue.
